name: Petal Reel
summary: A birthday page that plays like a short film in four parts and ends in a heart of flowers
about: A birthday surprise that plays like a little film with letterbox bars, film grain and subtitles. Part one counts down to midnight under a rising moon, part two brings the sunrise, balloons and the name in confetti, part three hangs three photos on a string, and part four blooms dozens of flowers into a beating heart around the name. Change the names and the last line, copy the link and send it as a surprise.
how: Press the big play button: the letterbox bars slide in and the film starts with a 3-2-1 countdown.
Use the controls to pause, jump to any of the four parts or watch again; the bars under each part fill as it plays.
In Make it yours, type the birthday name, your name and a last line; the film and the ticket preview update as you type.
Press Copy link: the link carries your words, so whoever opens it sees their own film.
With reduced motion every part still plays, as calm fades without the big movement.
